title: Olive oil 500 ml: fill, cap, wrap label

product.name: 500 ml dark olive oil bottle
product.description: Dark glass 500 ml olive-oil bottle, about 70 mm across and 280 mm tall, with a black screw cap. Filled with olive oil, then capped, then a wrap-around label is applied to the front.

steps.name: Fill
steps.does: Fill each bottle with olive oil to the required fill level acceptance range (target corresponds to 220 ml).

steps.name: Cap
steps.does: Screw on the black cap to each filled bottle.

steps.name: Label
steps.does: Apply a wrap-around label to the front of each capped bottle (label size 20×20 mm).

steps.name: BottleValidCheck
steps.does: Check bottle validity: ensure fill level is within the acceptance range (210–235 ml) and cap is present. Mark invalid units for removal from the belt.

steps.name: DiscardRejects
steps.does: Remove rejected bottles from the belt so only valid bottles continue.

quality: BottleValidCheck marks units invalid if fill volume is outside 210–235 ml and/or the cap is not present; DiscardRejects ejects marked units from the single-file belt.
constraints: Single-file bottle flow on a belt at a fixed pitch (no accumulation requested).
Rejections must be discarded from the belt (no rework loop requested).
Label is wrap-around, nominal size 20×20 mm on the front of each bottle.
assumptions: No shift length provided: assumed 8 hours/day for scheduling (takt derived from 300 bottles/hour).
No pitch provided: assumed a recommended bottle pitch of 0.25 m center-to-center to set belt speed and station timing.
“220 mm volume target yes” interpreted as 220 ml target fill volume; acceptance is exactly 210–235 ml as stated.
BottleValidCheck includes only fill-level acceptance and cap-present validation (no additional cap torque/height validation and no label-position/readability validation requested).
Label is applied to all bottles upstream; invalid-label handling is not included in validity since only fill level and cap present were specified.
